data.general: This period may bring about a sense of restlessness and impulsive behavior, Vrishabha, due to Mars' presence in your 1st house. With Sun and Jupiter in your 3rd house, there is a potential for increased communication and learning, but be cautious not to get overly critical. Moon in Scorpio in your 7th house suggests a need to navigate emotional relationships carefully.
data.luck: Your luck may seem to be on a downturn, with Saturn's restrictive influence in your 11th house. However, Rahu in your 10th house can bring about unexpected opportunities, so stay vigilant and adaptable.
data.scope: This period may see a focus on personal growth and self-improvement, with the Sun and Jupiter in your 3rd house. Use this energy to learn new skills and expand your horizons.
data.study: With Mercury in your 2nd house and Jupiter in your 3rd house, this is a great time to focus on intellectual pursuits and education. You may find yourself naturally drawn to learning and self-improvement.
data.love: Moon in Scorpio in your 7th house can create intense emotional connections, but be careful not to let emotions overwhelm you. With Venus in your 4th house, you may be focusing on emotional security and stability in your relationships.
data.travel: There may be a desire for adventure and exploration, but with Saturn's restrictive influence, you may need to carefully consider your travel plans and budget.
